payload.text: Quero criar um sistema de registro de ponto de funcionario com reconhecimento facial

**Considering Facial Recognition**

I'm currently focused on the facial recognition aspect of this employee time-tracking system. My primary approach involves capturing images via camera and then employing Gemini, specifically `gemini-3-flash-preview` or `gemini-2.5-flash-image`, to identify and verify employees. This is a critical step for accurately recording attendance.


**Developing System Components**

I've been mapping out the key components. I'm building a system with simulated employee data in local storage, logging clock-in/out times, and tracking geolocation. The UI/UX is planned with Tailwind. I will use React and TypeScript, incorporating the Gemini API (`@google/genai`). My core approach includes simulating facial "enrollment" and verification in the browser via `gemini-3-flash-preview` to address limitations. I have also decided on the basic file architecture to support this.
